description: This source file defines the `CreditBureauToken` entity class for the Fineract project, representing a token used to authenticate with credit bureau services. It includes fields for username, token, token type, expiration info, and methods to construct an instance from a JSON command.

classes.name: CreditBureauToken
classes.description: Entity class representing a credit bureau token with fields mapped to database columns, and a static method to instantiate from a JSON command.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of `CreditBureauToken` from a JSON command, parsing relevant fields and converting the expiry date string into a LocalDate.
